summary: Kerb on a signalised junction approach with a median island; no room to stop.

best_section.where: West kerb of Moorak Street on the approach to the main-road junction

drivers.seclusion: House 12 m and Bona Place apartments 16 m away on the same side.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb runs along a widened junction approach with a painted island; no parked cars seen and no space to pull out of the lane.
drivers.traffic: Busy junction with lanes and signals; noisy.
drivers.convention: Resident-permit 2P signs; no cars parked on this stretch.

sun_shade: Open to the sky; trees shade the east side only.
